title: Carbamate and Sulfamate Bioisosteres of N,N-Dimethyl-3beta-Hydroxycholenamide as Ligands of the Liver X Receptors.
authors: Pegenaute, Malena; Pugliese, Micaela B; Perez, Facundo; Di Salvo, Florencia; Misico, Rosana I; Dansey, Maria V; Alvarez, Lautaro D; Burton, Gerardo; Martinez, Mario D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究LXR受体小分子配体的合成与活性，虽含分子动力学模拟但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Modulating activity of liver X receptors (LXR) has garnered increasing interest, as its principal endogenous ligands, oxysterols, are implicated in diverse disorders, including atherosclerosis and metabolic syndrome. N,N-dimethyl-3beta-hydroxycholenamide (DMHCA, 1), a synthetic LXR ligand, exhibits promising features and a favorable safety profile without elevating triglycerides or inducing hepatic steatosis. Here, we describe the synthesis, biological profile, and mode of action against LXR isoforms, of two novel side chain bioisosteric analogues of DMHCA (1) where the dimethylamide was replaced by a N,N-dimethyl carbamate (2) or sulfamate (3). These compounds were obtained in good yields via a simple synthetic sequence starting from stigmasterol, a readily available phytosterol byproduct from the soybean industry. Both analogues 2 and 3 exhibited agonistic activity comparable to DMHCA (1) in luciferase reporter assays in human HEK-293 T cells, although sulfamate (3) proved to be more effective (LXRalpha/1 pEC(50) = 6.4; LXRbeta/1 pEC(50) = 6.4; LXRalpha/2 pEC(50) = 5.3; LXRbeta/2 pEC(50) = 5.6; LXRalpha/3 pEC(50) = 6.0; LXRbeta/3 pEC(50) = 6.1). Molecular dynamics simulations of the LXRbeta/ligand complexes confirmed a stable binding mode consistent with the dose-response data in all cases. The results set the foundation for developing novel analogues based on these compounds, particularly with sulfamate (3).
abstract_zh: 调节肝X受体（LXR）的活性日益引起关注，因其主要内源性配体氧固醇（oxysterols）与多种疾病相关，包括动脉粥样硬化和代谢综合征。N,N-二甲基-3β-羟基胆烯酰胺（DMHCA, 1）是一种合成的LXR配体，展现出良好的特性及有利的安全性，不会升高甘油三酯或诱导肝脂肪变性。在此，我们描述了两种新型DMHCA（1）侧链生物电子等排类似物的合成、生物学特性及其对LXR亚型的作用机制，其中二甲基酰胺被N,N-二甲基氨基甲酸酯（2）或氨基磺酸酯（3）取代。这些化合物通过从豆甾醇（一种来自大豆工业的易得植物甾醇副产品）出发的简单合成序列，以良好产率获得。在人HEK-293 T细胞的荧光素酶报告基因实验中，类似物2和3均表现出与DMHCA（1）相当的激动活性，尽管氨基磺酸酯（3）被证明更为有效（LXRα/1 pEC(50) = 6.4；LXRβ/1 pEC(50) = 6.4；LXRα/2 pEC(50) = 5.3；LXRβ/2 pEC(50) = 5.6；LXRα/3 pEC(50) = 6.0；LXRβ/3 pEC(50) = 6.1）。LXRβ/配体复合物的分子动力学模拟在所有情况下均确认了与剂量反应数据一致的稳定结合模式。这些结果为基于这些化合物（特别是氨基磺酸酯（3））开发新型类似物奠定了基础。
